subject: I wasn't going to send this VIP confession
preview_text: Truth: I set aside one last thing for 30-day users. It expires tomorrow at midnight. Don't skip this.
body_paragraphs: Confession time. I've been holding onto something. For the last 29 days, I've watched a small group of couples actually use SoulPlan, not just download it. You're in that group. And I made a rule for myself: if someone stuck around for the full 30 days, they got access to something I don't give anyone else.

Tomorrow marks 30 days since you joined. So this is the thing. It's not just a discount. It's the full SoulPlan Premium experience—the AI that learns your inside jokes, the surprise date planner that actually works, the entire local discovery map—but at a price I literally cannot offer after tonight. I built it as a thank you for the couples who showed up. Think of it as the 'keep the spark alive' starter kit, with everything unlocked.

The offer lives inside the app. Open SoulPlan, and on the home screen, you'll see it. 'Your 30-Day Access.' Tap it. You'll see the whole value stack: personalized AI, surprise planning, all the premium filters for budget and vibe, and date history tracking so you never repeat a dud. It turns the app from a nice idea into your secret weapon against routine.

This disappears tomorrow at midnight. No extensions, no codes later. This was the deal I made with myself. Open SoulPlan now and tap 'Your 30-Day Access' on the home screen to see what I set aside for you. P.S. The 92% of couples who said this improved their relationship? They all started right where you are now.
